Hi Alex — welcome, excited to get started. I’ve sketched an enablement curriculum tailored to an SI partner who will both implement and maintain Redwood for customer deployments. Primary goals: reduce ramp time, ensure predictable deployment quality, and enable co-delivery.

Enablement modules (deliverables):
1) Platform fundamentals (90m workshop) — auth, model catalog, routing policies, SLOs. Deliverable: one-page quickstart.
2) Integration patterns (90m workshop) — connectors (vector dbs, RAG), prefix/KV caching, fallback routing. Deliverable: example integration repo + CI test harness.
3) Performance & cost controls (60m) — batching, quantization recommendations, telemetry. Deliverable: tuning checklist + cost model template.
4) Ops & runbooks (self-study + 60m review) — rollout patterns, rollback, incident playbooks. Deliverable: templated runbook and monitoring dashboard links.

Certification path:
- Pass two role-based practical checks (SE deploys a sample integration in staging + validates latency/cost targets)
- Complete written checklist and submit a small customer-facing solution brief (we’ll review)

Logistics & sandbox access:
- We can provision a dedicated staging project for Synergy with RBAC for two SEs. For SSO/SCIM we’ll need an admin contact and a short form (I’ll attach SSO setup).
- Estimated effort to onboard: ~2 engineer-days from Redwood to provision + 1 enablement lead day for workshops.

I uploaded a draft solution brief to Drive and attached a PDF copy here. Please review and suggest edits; we can co-brand the brief for the pilot customer.

Docs / Links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/synergy-onboarding
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/SY-2483
